headline: Amazon is complaining about NYC Council on shipping labels, too
summary: Amazon is fighting the NYC Council's Delivery Protection Act. The company adds labels claiming a potential $5 order increase. The act targets Amazon's third-party delivery model.

headline: The UN fails to agree on rules regulating ‘killer robots’
summary: UN diplomats failed to establish rules for autonomous weapons. Negotiations in Geneva ended with only an agreement to discuss options. The week-long meetings proved largely fruitless.

headline: The FBI and USDA were reportedly hacked
summary: Both the FBI and USDA have reportedly been hacked. This is the FBI's second hack in recent months. The attack targeted the sensitive National Crime Information Center.

headline: John Roberts, the voice of Linda Belcher, is just happy to finish a thing
summary: John Roberts, voice of Linda Belcher, reflects on his career. Bob's Burgers just wrapped its 16th successful season. Roberts finds joy in completing projects beyond comedy.

headline: These Piranha Plant Slippers Double as Mario-themed Decor When You Put Them Away
summary: Piranha Plant slippers offer unique Mario-themed comfort. They double as fun decorative items when not worn. A creative way to integrate gaming into home decor.

headline: The Binding of Isaac Dev Removes Undisclosed AI-Generated Music From Repentance+ Following Creator Response, Review-Bombing
summary: Nicalis removed hidden AI music from Binding of Isaac: Repentance+. This followed significant backlash and a Steam review-bombing campaign. Game creator Edmund McMillen also addressed the issue.

headline: Fossil fuel dispute threatens to derail COP31 climate deal
summary: A fossil fuel dispute is jeopardizing the COP31 climate agreement. The UN summit in Turkey is now in its second day of overtime. Countries are struggling to reach a consensus.

headline: Catherine talks openly about how cancer changed her in documentary on BBC
summary: Catherine discusses her cancer journey in a new BBC documentary. She highlights the profound changes a cancer diagnosis brings. The film will air on BBC One on November 29.

summary: Catherine shares insights on facing life's challenges in a new clip. She emphasizes that 'cancer does change you' in a powerful documentary. The full program airs November 29 on BBC One.

headline: Spitting Image co-creator Peter Fluck dies aged 85
summary: Peter Fluck, co-creator of Spitting Image, has passed away at 85. He died at his Cornwall home after a recent illness. Fluck was instrumental in the iconic satirical show's success.
